stem.zh-CN: 关于[[term:kv-cache|KV Cache]]在[[term:autoregressive-inference|自回归推理]]中的作用，最准确的是:
stem.en-US: What is the most accurate description of the role of [[term:kv-cache|KV Cache]] in [[term:autoregressive-inference|autoregressive inference]]?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:kv-cache|KV Cache]] 保存历史 [[term:token|token]] 的 Key 与 Value，大幅减少重复运算。
explanation.en-US: [[term:kv-cache|KV Cache]] stores the Key and Value tensors of historical [[term:token|tokens]], greatly reducing repeated computation.

primaryConcept.en-US: Reusing historical K/V in KV Cache

taxonomy.engineeringStage: E9 推理与运行时优化

text.zh-CN: 减少参数量，从而降低模型存储体积
text.en-US: Reduce the number of parameters and therefore reduce model storage

text.zh-CN: 缓存历史[[term:token|token]]的[[term:qkv-projection|K/V]]，避免每步重复计算
text.en-US: Cache the [[term:qkv-projection|K/V]] of historical [[term:token|tokens]] to avoid recomputing them at every step

text.zh-CN: 让模型在推理时不再需要[[term:self-attention|注意力机制]]
text.en-US: Remove the need for [[term:self-attention|attention]] during inference
